blocks.prompt: 10. The end towers of a suspension bridge are 100 meters high and 540 meters apart. The suspension cable hangs from the top of the towers in the form of a parabola and the lowest point of the cable is 25 meters above the horizontal road. Find the length of the supporting vertical cable at a horizontal distance of 81 meters from the centre of the bridge.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh Example 31 jaisa suspension bridge hai, bas cable ka lowest point road se 25 m ooper hai.
Diya kya hai? Towers 100 m oonche, aapas mein 540 m door; cable ka sab se neecha point road se 25 m ooper.
Find kya karna hai? Centre se 81 m door khari (vertical) supporting cable ki lambai.
Plan: vertex ko origin, \(x^2 = 4ay\), tower ki choti se \(4a\), phir \(x = 81\) par cable ki oonchai, aur aakhir mein road tak ke 25 m jama.
steps:
Diya gaya: towers 100 m oonche aur 540 m door; cable ka lowest point road se 25 m ooper.
Maloom karna: centre se 81 m door vertical cable ki lambai.
Tareeqa: origin cable ke lowest point par, \(y\)-axis bridge ke centre se khari. Is tarah road line \(y = -25\) ban jati hai. Latakti cable ooper khulti hai: \(x^2 = 4ay\).

Tower ki choti
\[\dfrac{540}{2} = 270,\quad 100 - 25 = 75\]
\[B(270,\ 75)\]
Kyun: har tower centre se 270 m door hai. Tower road se 100 m ooncha hai, lekin hamara origin road se 25 m ooper hai, is liye origin se tower ki choti \(100 - 25 = 75\) m ooper hai.
Dhyan dein: yahan 100 rakh dena sab se aam ghalti hai; height hamesha origin (vertex) se naapni hai.

\(4a\) nikalein
\[270^2 = 4a(75)\]
\[72900 = 300a \Rightarrow 4a = 972\]
\[x^2 = 972y\]
Kyun: point \(B\) cable par hai, is liye us ke coordinates \(x^2 = 4ay\) ko satisfy karte hain. \(270^2 = 72900\) aur \(4 \times 75 = 300\), to \(a = 243\) aur \(4a = 972\). Ab cable ki poori equation hamare paas hai; is se kisi bhi jagah cable ki oonchai nikal sakte hain.

Centre se 81 m door cable
\[81^2 = 972y\]
\[y = \dfrac{6561}{972} = 6.75\]
Kyun: \(x = 81\) rakha. Yeh batata hai ke yahan cable apne lowest point se 6.75 m ooper hai.

Vertical cable ki lambai
\[6.75 + 25 = 31.75 \text{ m}\]
Kyun: vertical cable main cable se road tak jati hai. Main cable lowest point se 6.75 m ooper hai, aur lowest point road se 25 m ooper; dono jama karne se poori lambai.
Dhyan dein: sirf 6.75 m jawab dena adhoora hai; road tak ka 25 m ka hissa bhi cable hi hai.

Tasdeeq
\[x = 270:\ y = \dfrac{72900}{972} = 75 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: cable tower ki choti tak pohanchti hai, jo road se \(75 + 25 = 100\) m ooper hai, bilkul jaisa diya tha.
